segments.contextAfter: `MaximumFailedAttempts` (integer): The number of failed passcode attempts that the system allows the user before it erases or locks the device. After six failed attempts, the device imposes a time delay before the user can enter a passcode again. The time delay increases with each failed attempt. On macOS, set `FailedAttemptsResetInMinutes` to define the time delay. The time delay begins after the sixth attempt, so if `MaximumFailedAttempts` is six or lower, the system has no time delay and triggers the erase or lock as soon as the user exceeds the limit. After the final failed attempt, the system locks a macOS device, or securely erases all data and settings from an iOS, visionOS, or watchOS device.
